comment:
Rita.
The weather's scourge has frightened the people,
driving them into thousands of wet houses.
Only I have no peace in such weather,
which even love torments me.

My grief has surrounded the vast dwelling,
like a military camp encircling the entire fortress,
losing hopes, firearms, and food
under the drops from the sky, like a thousand stings.

Grains fall from the hail clouds,
like rice from a funeral kutia,
more than adding to the sadness of the scene
and wounding my soaked fabrics.

A foul, fresh-breathing wind chills,
swaying the flickering lamplight.
The dirt paths are covered in a hundred erosions,
like a heart that has known many sorrows.

Trapped in the clutches of jagged fences and branches,
brick refinements and stacked slabs,
the extinguished two-colored tints of my cigarettes,
I watch the daily grind unfold.

I, starved for happiness,
standing in the well of apartment bondage,
frozen, rejected by feminine power,
I lean my shoulder against a birch tree trunk.

The whole evening, cold, damp, unsociable,
like a wolf gazing at the moon in the sky,
I stand under the window of my unrequited lover
with the great dream of a homeless dog...

author: @KabbalahSherry
comment:
Sorry.... I'm not excited.  ??? There's been an annoying level of fan fiction going on, and it's been sh*tshow ½ of the time, let's just be honest. 

Showing Alicent only supporting her son Aegon because she misunderstood Vicerys on his deathbed was ridiculous, and a complete whitewashing of her character. In the novella, she doesn't give a d*mn about Vicerys! She leaves his dead body to sit & rot for 3+ days, so she can shut down the castle & hide the fact that he'd died, while her & the Small Council conspire on how they're going to steal Rhaenyra's birthright from her. Otto had been planning & plotting to do it for 20+ years! Alicent KNOWS what her son is & how bad a ruler he'd be, but the Greens support him regardless. Yet in the show, they got Alicent having doubts & showing regret for what she's done, and even sneaking over to Rhaenyra, so she can aide her in taking King's Landing, like....??  WTF?! 

Alicent, having a conscious?! Since when?! What is this fan fiction?! Its insane. Of course I'll watch the show regardless but... just because there's cool looking dragons or the music is still really good, that doesn't mean it's been a successful telling of the story, because it hasn't! I didn't need to see Daemon killing his 1st wife just to make him look worse, or him having weirwood dreams for 5+ episodes, including one where he's f*cking his own Mother. 

A woman he didn't even KNOW, because she died when he was 3yrs old. Again... WTF?!?!

It cracks me up that people were sooo pissed off about the Valeryons being a Black/Mixed Race family, as if THAT was somehow going to be the worst thing they did with the show...when their race doesn't even matter or effect ANYTHING. But you know what does?! Terrible writing. Fan Fiction that nobody asked for. Completely changing character's natures, motivations & actions. THAT will ruin a story far more than anything else ever could. Get it together HBO
